pairs: Hæc sunt verba quæ locutus est Moyses ad omnem Israël trans Jordanem in solitudine campestri,
These are the words which Moses spoke to all of Israel, across the Jordan, in the plain of the wilderness opposite the Red Sea,
contra mare Rubrum, inter Pharan et Tophel et Laban et Haseroth,
between Paran and Tophel and Laban and Hazeroth,
undecim diebus de Horeb per viam montis Seir usque ad Cadesbarne.
eleven days from Horeb, by way of Mount Seir as far as Kadesh-barnea.
on the first day of the month,
locutus est Moyses ad filios Israël omnia quæ præceperat illi Dominus,
Moses told the sons of Israel all that the Lord had instructed him.
And so he spoke to them,
after he had struck down Sihon, the king of the Amorites,
who lived at Heshbon, and Og,
qui mansit in Astaroth, et in Edrai,
who resided at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
across the Jordan in the land of Moab.
And so, Moses began to explain the law,
Dominus Deus noster locutus est ad nos in Horeb,
“The Lord our God spoke to us at Horeb,
Sufficit vobis quod in hoc monte mansistis:
‘You have remained long enough on this mountain.
revertimini, et venite ad montem Amorrhæorum,
Turn back and go to the mountain of the Amorites, and to the other places which are near it:
et ad cetera quæ ei proxima sunt campestria atque montana et humiliora loca contra meridiem, et juxta littus maris,
the plains as well as the mountainous regions, and the low-lying places opposite the south and along the shore of the sea,
et Libani usque ad flumen magnum Euphraten.
and Lebanon, as far as the great river Euphrates.’
Enter and possess that which the Lord swore to your fathers,
super qua juravit Dominus patribus vestris Abraham,
that he would give it to them,
and to their offspring after them.’
And I said to you, at that time:
‘I alone am not able to sustain you.
quia Dominus Deus vester multiplicavit vos,
For the Lord, your God, has multiplied you,
et estis hodie sicut stellæ cæli,
and you are today like the stars of heaven,
(Dominus Deus patrum vestrorum addat ad hunc numerum multa millia,
May the Lord, the God of your fathers, add to this number many thousands more,
et benedicat vobis sicut locutus est.)
and may he bless you, just as he has said.
Non valeo solus negotia vestra sustinere,
I do not have the strength to endure your arbitrations and judgments and disputes.
Date ex vobis viros sapientes et gnaros,
Offer, from among you, wise and experienced men,
et quorum conversatio sit probata in tribubus vestris,
those whose conversation has been proven within your tribes,
so that I may appoint them as your rulers.’
Bona res est, quam vis facere.
‘What you intend to do is a good thing.’
Tulique de tribubus vestris viros sapientes et nobiles,
And so, I took from your tribes men, wise and noble,
and I appointed them as rulers,
and as leaders over fifty and over ten,
who would teach you each thing.
whether he is one of your citizens
There shall be no favoritism to any persons.
So you shall listen to the little as well as to the great.
And you shall not accept anyone’s reputation,
for this is the judgment of God.
Quod si difficile vobis visum aliquid fuerit,
But if anything seems difficult to you,
And I instructed you in all that you were obliged to do.
transivimus per eremum terribilem et maximam,
we crossed through a terrible and great wasteland,
which you saw along the way of the mountain of the Amorite,
sicut præceperat Dominus Deus noster nobis.
just as the Lord our God had instructed us.
And when we had arrived at Kadesh-barnea,
‘You have arrived at the mountain of the Amorite,
quem Dominus Deus noster daturus est nobis:
which the Lord our God will give to us.
Gaze upon the land that the Lord your God gives to you.
quam Dominus Deus tuus dat tibi:
sicut locutus est Dominus Deus noster patribus tuis:
just as the Lord our God has spoken to your fathers.
and do not become terrified by anything.’
‘Let us send men who may consider the land,
et renuntient per quod iter debeamus ascendere,
and who may report as to the way by which we ought to ascend,
and as to which cities we ought to travel.’
And since the word was pleasing to me,
I sent from among you twelve men,
when they had set out and had ascended the mountains,
arrived as far as the valley of the cluster of grapes.
sumentes de fructibus ejus, ut ostenderent ubertatem,
having taken from its fruits in order to show its fertility,
Bona est terra, quam Dominus Deus noster daturus est nobis.
‘The land that the Lord our God will give to us is good.’
Yet you were not willing to go there.
sed increduli ad sermonem Domini Dei nostri,
Instead, being incredulous to the word of the Lord our God,
et idcirco eduxit nos de terra Ægypti,
and therefore he has led us away from the land of Egypt,
ut traderet nos in manu Amorrhæi,
so that he might deliver us into the hand of the Amorite
The messengers have terrified our heart by saying:
et nobis statura procerior; urbes magnæ,
and taller than us. And the cities are great,
and the walls extend even to the sky.
We have seen the sons of the Anakim there.”’
sicut fecit in Ægypto cunctis videntibus.
just as he did in Egypt in the sight of all.
Et in solitudine (ipse vidisti) portavit te Dominus Deus tuus,
And in the wilderness (as you yourselves saw), the Lord your God carried you,
ut solet homo gestare parvulum filium suum,
like a man who is accustomed to carrying his little son,
in omni via per quam ambulastis,
along all the way that you walked,
until you arrived at this place.’
Et nec sic quidem credidistis Domino Deo vestro,
And yet, despite all of this, you did not believe the Lord your God,
who went before you on the way,
et metatus est locum in quo tentoria figere deberetis,
and who marked out the place where you should pitch your tents,
nocte ostendens vobis iter per ignem,
showing you the way by fire in the night,
and by a pillar of cloud in the day.
Cumque audisset Dominus vocem sermonum vestrorum,
And when the Lord had heard the voice of your words,
Non videbit quispiam de hominibus generationis hujus pessimæ terram bonam,
‘None of the men of this wicked generation will see the good land,
quam sub juramento pollicitus sum patribus vestris,
which I have promised by oath to your fathers,
except Caleb the son of Jephuneh.
For he himself will see it,
et ipsi dabo terram, quam calcavit, et filiis ejus,
and I will give the land on which he has walked to him and to his sons,
because he has followed the Lord.’
Neither is his indignation with the people a wonder,
cum mihi quoque iratus Dominus propter vos dixerit:
since the Lord also became angry with me because of you, and so he said:
‘Neither will you enter into that place.
sed Josue filius Nun minister tuus,
But Joshua, the son of Nun, your minister,
shall himself enter on your behalf.
et ipse sorte terram dividet Israëli.
and he himself shall divide the land by lot to Israel.
de quibus dixistis quod captivi ducerentur,
about whom you said that they would be led away as captives,
who to this day are ignorant of the difference between good and evil,
And I will give the land to them,
et abite in solitudinem per viam maris Rubri.
turn back and go out to the wilderness, by way of the Red Sea.’
just as the Lord our God has instructed.’
And having been equipped with weapons,
Cumque instructi armis pergeretis in montem,
when you were setting out for the mountain,
Do not ascend and do not fight.
For I am not with you.
you may fall in the sight of your enemies.’
I spoke, and you did not listen.
But, opposing the order of the Lord,
And so, having gone forth, the Amorite,
who was living in the mountains,
et obviam veniens, persecutus est vos,
came against you and pursued you,
just as a swarm of bees would do.
et cecidit de Seir usque Horma.
And he struck you down from Seir all the way to Hormah.
And when you returned and were weeping in the sight of the Lord,
nor was he willing to agree to your voice.
Sedistis ergo in Cadesbarne multo tempore.
Therefore, you camped at Kadesh-barnea for a long time.”
